name: Solenoids
summary: Electromagnets that pull or push a plunger: door locks, latches, valves and starters.
identify: A coil around a sliding steel plunger: in car door locks, vending machines, washer door locks, pinball machines and electric door strikes. The coil voltage is often on the label.
test: Feed the rated DC voltage: the plunger should snap in. The coil should show continuity.
